feats.title: Mastery of Knives
feats.description: You gain proficiency with the kukri and katar, and you can treat them as daggers for the purpose of casting sorcerer spells.

feats.title: Sorcerous Blade Channeling
feats.description: When you use any ranged sorcerer attack power through a dagger, you can use the power as a melee attack. If you do so, the power's range equals your melee reach.

feats.title: Arcane Spellfury
feats.description: When you hit any enemy with a sorcerer at-will attack power, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Focusing Spellfury
feats.description: When you use a sorcerer at-will attack power and hit two or more enemies, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with ranged and melee attack powers until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Rising Spellfury
feats.description: When you use a sorcerer at-will attack power and hit only one enemy, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with area and close attack powers until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Leatherbound Sorcerer
feats.description: You become proficient in leather armor.

feats.title: Armored Sorcerer
feats.description: When wearing leather armor, any resistance you gain from your Spell Source class feature increases by 2.

feats.title: Tempest Magic
feats.description: When you use an arcane power that has the lightning or thunder keyword, you gain a +1 feat bonus to damage rolls. While you are bloodied, this bonus becomes +2. At 11th level, this bonus increases to +2 (or +4 when bloodied). At 21st level, it increases to +3 (or +6 when bloodied).

feats.title: Improved Dragon Soul
feats.description: The resistance granted by your Dragon Soul increases by 2. The increase changes to 5 at 11th level and 10 at 21st level.

feats.title: Coincidental Success
feats.description: Once per encounter when you make a skill check as a part of a skill challenge, choose 1–10 or 11–20. If the result of the d20 roll for that skill check is within the range selected, you automatically earn one success for that skill challenge.

feats.title: Disciplined Wild Soul
feats.description: When determining your Wild Soul damage type, roll twice and use either result.

feats.title: Distracting Coincidences
feats.description: Targets you slide with sorcerer attacks or your Unfettered Power take a -2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Fortunate Resistance
feats.description: When you roll for your Wild Soul resistance, choose 1–5 or 6–10. If the result of your first die roll is within the range selected, you can choose any result to replace that die roll.

feats.title: Gambler’s Initiative
feats.description: Before rolling an initiative check, choose even numbers or odd numbers. If the result of the d20 roll for that initiative check matches the type of number selected, you gain a feat bonus to that initiative check equal to your Charisma.

feats.title: Unlucky Teleport
feats.description: Enemies you teleport with sorcerer powers or with sorcerer paragon path powers or class features take 1d10 psychic damage

feats.title: Lucky Shot
feats.description: When you use a daily sorcerer attack power or a daily sorcerer paragon path attack power, for one attack roll choose even numbers or odd numbers. If the result of the d20 roll matches the type of number selected, you gain a feat bonus to the damage roll against the target equal to your Charisma for this attack

feats.title: Student of the Cosmos
feats.description:
You gain an additional benefit based on your current phase in the cosmic cycle:

- *Phase of the Sun:* You gain a +2 feat bonus to initiative checks.

- *Phase of the Moon:* You gain a +2 feat bonus to arcane technique checks.

- *Phase of the Stars:* You gain a +2 feat bonus to Skill Checks to hide or sneak.

feats.title: Cosmic Blade Channeling
feats.description:
Once per round, when you hit with an attack made using Sorcerous Blade Channeling, you gain a benefit based on your current phase:

- *Phase of the Sun:* You push the target 1 square.

- *Phase of the Moon:* You slide the target 1 square to a square adjacent to you.

- *Phase of the Stars:* You roll a saving throw.
